senses.sense_definition: To approach someone unexpectedly for an interview or questioning.

examples.text: The reporters <w>doorstepped</w> the politician as he left his home.

senses.sense_definition: To visit households one after another to solicit sales or support.

examples.text: The volunteers <w>doorstepped</w> the entire neighborhood to promote the candidate.
